checks.name: Genuine Circle worker completes before its mesh response is released
Guide and density edits remain available while a completed mesh is in transit
Late success retains newer edits and labels the actual result as needing update
Successful attempt records its original parameters
Stale successful result has a visible update badge
Native OBJ download matches the accepted worker output byte for byte
Native right-pane Polyline is authored over a genuine accepted toilet mesh
Generated-pane point edit snaps to the original source and commits once
Undo restores exact values after editing in the generated pane
Overlay uses one guide display over the accepted mesh
Actual rejected two-guide solve preserves the previous accepted mesh
Failure with a prior result is clearly labeled in the viewport
Retry produces a second genuinely completed toilet job
Late successful toilet mesh cannot overwrite a different source or its preview
Implementation remains fixed through the generated-result workflow

scope: Real browser/HTTP/Blender generations with genuine delayed successful responses; native OBJ download and editing on accepted geometry, stale success and prior-result failure handling. No substituted result fixture.
